machines.name: Lat Pulldown Machine
machines.what: A seat with a thigh pad and a long bar hanging from a cable above your head.

machines.name: Seated Cable Row
machines.what: A low bench with foot plates and a handle on a cable that you pull towards your stomach.

machines.name: Chest Press Machine
machines.what: A seat with a back pad and two handles at chest height that you push forward.

machines.name: Shoulder Press Machine
machines.what: A seat with a back pad and two handles at shoulder height that you push up.

machines.name: Leg Press Machine
machines.what: A reclined seat facing a large foot plate that you push away with your legs.

machines.name: Leg Extension Machine
machines.what: A seat with a padded bar in front of your shins that you lift by straightening your knees.

machines.name: Leg Curl Machine
machines.what: A seat or bench with a padded bar behind your ankles that you pull by bending your knees.

machines.name: Cable Machine
machines.what: A tall frame with adjustable pulleys and handles on cables.

machines.name: Smith Machine
machines.what: A barbell that slides up and down on fixed vertical rails inside a frame.

machines.name: Squat Rack / Power Rack
machines.what: A steel cage or two posts that hold a free barbell at shoulder height.

machines.name: Dumbbells
machines.what: Short hand weights, usually stored in pairs on a rack.

machines.name: Bench Press
machines.what: A flat bench under a barbell that rests on two uprights.

machines.name: Pec Deck (Chest Fly) Machine
machines.what: A seat with two arms at the sides that you squeeze together in front of your chest.

machines.name: Treadmill
machines.what: A moving belt you walk or run on, with a screen and handrails.

machines.name: Exercise Bike
machines.what: A bicycle that stays in one place, with pedals, a saddle and a screen.

machines.name: Rowing Machine
machines.what: A long rail with a sliding seat, foot straps and a handle on a chain.

machines.name: Exercise Mat
machines.what: A soft mat on the floor for body-weight exercises.

lat_pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown
lat_pulldown.plan: 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Rest 60-90 seconds between sets.
setup: Move the pin in the weight stack to a light weight. For your first time, pick a weight you could lift 15 times.
Adjust the thigh pad so it holds your legs down firmly when you sit.
Stand up, grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders, palms facing away, then sit down with the bar.
steps: Sit tall, chest up, and lean back just a little.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest. Think about pulling your elbows down to your back pockets.
Pause for one second at the bottom.
Let the bar go up slowly until your arms are straight again.
mistakes: Swinging the body back to move the weight.
Pulling the bar behind the neck.
Stopping halfway and not straightening the arms at the top.
Letting the weight crash back up.
lat_pulldown.safety: Never pull the bar behind your head. Stand up to return the bar, do not let it fly up.

camera.tip: Put the phone at your side, about 2-3 metres away, at chest height. Your whole upper body and the bar must be in the picture.

seated_cable_row.name: Seated Cable Row
seated_cable_row.plan: 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Rest 60-90 seconds between sets.
setup: Choose a light weight with the pin.
Sit on the bench and put your feet flat on the foot plates, knees slightly bent.
Reach forward, take the handle with both hands, then sit back until your back is straight and upright.
steps: Sit tall with a straight back and arms stretched in front of you.
Pull the handle to your stomach. Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pause for one second.
Let your arms go forward slowly until they are straight.
mistakes: Rocking the body forward and backward.
Rounding the lower back.
Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.
Pulling only halfway.
seated_cable_row.safety: Keep your back straight the whole time. If your back rounds, the weight is too heavy.

camera.tip: Put the phone at your side, 2-3 metres away, at chest height. Your hips, back and arms must be in the picture.

chest_press.name: Machine Chest Press
chest_press.plan: 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Rest 60-90 seconds between sets.
setup: Choose a light weight with the pin.
Adjust the seat height so the handles are level with the middle of your chest.
Sit with your back and head against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
steps: Grip the handles, elbows a little below shoulder height.
Push the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Pause for one second.
Bring the handles back slowly until your hands are near your chest.
mistakes: Lifting the back or head off the pad.
Locking the elbows hard at the end.
Short, half reps.
Seat too low, so the handles are at shoulder height.
chest_press.safety: Keep your back on the pad. Do not let the weight stack slam down.

camera.tip: Put the phone at your side, 2-3 metres away, at chest height. Your arm, shoulder and hip must be in the picture.

shoulder_press.name: Machine Shoulder Press
shoulder_press.plan: 3 sets of 8-12 reps. Rest 60-90 seconds between sets.
setup: Choose a light weight with the pin.
Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your shoulders.
Sit with your back flat on the pad and feet flat on the floor.
steps: Grip the handles with your elbows under your wrists.
Push the handles up until your arms are almost straight.
Pause for one second.
Lower slowly until your hands are level with your ears.
mistakes: Arching the lower back away from the pad.
Lowering only a little (half reps).
Pushing the head forward.
Using a weight that is too heavy.
shoulder_press.safety: Stop if you feel a sharp pain in the shoulder. Keep your lower back on the pad.

camera.tip: Put the phone at your side, 2-3 metres away, at shoulder height. Your arms must stay in the picture at the top.

leg_press.name: Leg Press
leg_press.plan: 3 sets of 10-15 reps. Rest 90 seconds between sets.
setup: Start with a light weight, or no plates at all.
Sit with your back and hips flat on the seat.
Put your feet on the plate, shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly out.
Push the plate a little and turn the safety handles to release it.
steps: Start with your legs almost straight. Do not lock your knees.
Bend your knees slowly and let the plate come towards you until your knees are at about 90 degrees.
Push the plate away through your whole foot.
Stop just before your knees lock. When you finish, turn the safety handles back.
mistakes: Locking the knees straight at the top.
Going too deep so the hips lift off the seat.
Knees falling inwards.
Lifting the heels off the plate.
Very short reps with too much weight.
leg_press.safety: Never lock your knees. Always put the safety handles back before you take your feet off.

camera.tip: Put the phone at your side, 2-3 metres away, at hip height. Your hip, knee and ankle must all be in the picture.

leg_extension.name: Leg Extension
leg_extension.plan: 3 sets of 10-15 reps. Rest 60 seconds between sets.
setup: Choose a light weight with the pin.
Move the back pad so your knees line up with the machine's pivot (the round joint on the side).
Set the leg pad so it rests on your shins, just above the ankles.
steps: Sit with your back on the pad and hold the side handles.
Straighten your knees to lift the pad until your legs are almost straight.
Pause for one second and squeeze your thighs.
Lower slowly to the start.
mistakes: Kicking the weight up fast.
Lifting the hips off the seat.
Not straightening the legs.
Dropping the weight on the way down.
leg_extension.safety: Use a light weight. This machine puts stress on the knee joint when the load is heavy.

camera.tip: Put the phone at your side, 2 metres away, at knee height. Your hip, knee and ankle must be in the picture.

leg_curl.name: Seated Leg Curl
leg_curl.plan: 3 sets of 10-15 reps. Rest 60 seconds between sets.
setup: Choose a light weight with the pin.
Move the back pad so your knees line up with the machine's pivot.
Lower the thigh pad onto your thighs. The leg pad sits behind your ankles.
steps: Start with your legs almost straight.
Bend your knees and pull the pad down and back as far as you can.
Pause for one second.
Let your legs straighten slowly.
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the seat.
Short reps that do not bend the knee to 90 degrees.
Letting the weight snap back.
Leaning forward to help.
leg_curl.safety: Move slowly. A fast return can strain the back of the knee.

camera.tip: Put the phone at your side, 2 metres away, at knee height. Your hip, knee and ankle must be in the picture.

triceps_pushdown.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
triceps_pushdown.plan: 3 sets of 10-15 reps. Rest 60 seconds between sets.
setup: Move the pulley to the highest position and attach a straight bar or a rope.
Choose a light weight with the pin.
Stand facing the machine, one small step back, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Hold the bar with your elbows bent and tucked into your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Pause for one second.
Let the bar rise slowly until your forearms are just above level. Your elbows stay at your sides.
mistakes: Elbows moving forward and back.
Leaning the body over the bar to push with body weight.
Not straightening the arms.
Letting the bar pull the hands up too high.
triceps_pushdown.safety: Keep your wrists straight. Do not let the weight stack slam.

camera.tip: Put the phone at your side, 2-3 metres away, at chest height. Your whole body should be in the picture.

squat.name: Squat
squat.plan: 3 sets of 8-12 reps. Learn the movement with no weight first.
setup: Set the bar a little below shoulder height. For your first time, use the empty bar or no bar.
Set the safety bars or stops just below the lowest point of your squat.
Stand under the bar so it rests on the muscles of your upper back, not on your neck.
Feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly out.
steps: Take a breath and tighten your stomach.
Push your hips back and bend your knees, as if sitting on a chair.
Go down until your thighs are level with the floor. Keep your chest up and heels on the floor.
Push through your whole foot to stand up straight.
mistakes: Stopping too high (shallow squat).
Leaning the chest far forward.
Knees falling inwards.
Heels lifting off the floor.
Rounding the lower back.
squat.safety: Always set the safety bars. Ask a trainer to watch your first sets with weight.

camera.tip: Put the phone at your side, 3 metres away, at hip height. Your whole body from head to feet must be in the picture.

bicep_curl.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
bicep_curl.plan: 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Rest 60 seconds between sets.
setup: Pick two light dumbbells. A weight you can lift 15 times is right for learning.
Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, arms straight down, palms facing forward.
steps: Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Bend your elbows and lift the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Squeeze for one second at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Leaning back to swing the weight up.
Elbows moving forward (the shoulder does the work).
Not lifting all the way to the shoulder.
Dropping the weight on the way down.
bicep_curl.safety: If you must lean back to lift, the dumbbells are too heavy.

camera.tip: Put the phone at your side, 2-3 metres away, at chest height. Your whole upper body must be in the picture.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.plan: 3 sets of 8-10 reps on each leg. Start with no weight.
setup: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, or use no weight for your first time.
steps: Take a big step forward with one leg.
Lower your body straight down until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Your front knee stays above your ankle. Your back knee stops just above the floor.
Push through your front heel to come back to standing.
mistakes: Front knee going far past the toes.
Leaning the upper body forward.
Step too short.
Not going down far enough.
lunge.safety: Keep your front heel on the floor. Stop if your knee hurts.

camera.tip: Put the phone at your side, 3 metres away, at hip height. Your whole body must be in the picture.

bench_press.name: Barbell Bench Press
bench_press.plan: 3 sets of 8-10 reps. Start with the empty bar.
setup: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders.
Ask someone to stand behind the bar (a spotter) for your first sets.
steps: Lift the bar off the hooks and hold it above your chest with straight arms.
Lower the bar slowly to the middle of your chest.
Push the bar up until your arms are straight.
Put the bar back on the hooks when you finish.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Lifting the hips off the bench.
Half reps that do not reach the chest.
Elbows flared straight out to the sides.
bench_press.safety: Do not bench press alone with a heavy bar. Never use a thumbless grip.

camera.tip: Put the phone at your side, 3 metres away, at bench height. Your arm must be visible. Plates can block the view, so this check is less exact.

plank.name: Plank
plank.plan: 3 holds of 20-30 seconds. Rest 30 seconds between holds.
setup: Kneel on the mat and put your forearms on the floor, elbows under your shoulders.
Step your feet back one at a time until your legs are straight.
steps: Make a straight line from your head to your heels.
Tighten your stomach and squeeze your glutes.
Look at the floor a little in front of your hands.
Breathe normally and hold.
mistakes: Hips sagging towards the floor (low back).
Hips pushed up high (high back).
Holding the breath.
Looking up or forward.
plank.safety: Stop when your hips start to sag. A short good plank is better than a long bad one.

camera.tip: Put the phone on the floor at your side, 2-3 metres away. Your whole body from head to feet must be in the picture.

pec_deck_fly.name: Pec Deck Fly
pec_deck_fly.plan: 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Rest 60 seconds between sets.
setup: Choose a light weight with the pin.
Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your chest.
Sit with your back flat on the pad.
steps: Hold the handles with a small bend in your elbows.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest, like hugging a big tree.
Squeeze for one second.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest. Do not go further back than your shoulders.
mistakes: Opening the arms too far back.
Bending the elbows a lot so it becomes a press.
Shoulders rolling forward.
pec_deck_fly.safety: Do not let the handles pull your arms far behind your body.

camera.tip: Form check is not ready for this machine yet.

treadmill_walk.name: Treadmill Walk / Jog
treadmill_walk.plan: 10-20 minutes. Start with a walk at 4-5 km/h.
setup: Stand on the side rails, not on the belt.
Clip the red safety key to your shirt.
Press Start. The belt begins slowly. Then step on.
steps: Walk in the middle of the belt and look forward.
Raise the speed in small steps.
Swing your arms naturally. Do not hold the handrails all the time.
To finish, lower the speed, walk for two minutes, then press Stop and wait until the belt stops.
mistakes: Looking down at your feet.
Holding the rails and leaning back.
Stepping off while the belt is moving.
treadmill_walk.safety: Always use the safety key. Never jump on a moving belt.

camera.tip: Form check is not ready for this machine yet.

bike_ride.name: Exercise Bike
bike_ride.plan: 10-20 minutes at an easy effort where you can still talk.
setup: Set the saddle to hip height when you stand next to the bike.
Sit and put your feet in the straps.
At the lowest point of the pedal, your knee should be slightly bent.
steps: Start pedalling with low resistance.
Keep your back long and your shoulders relaxed.
Add resistance in small steps.
Finish with two easy minutes.
mistakes: Saddle too low (knees come up very high).
Saddle too high (hips rock side to side).
Rounding the back and gripping the handles hard.
bike_ride.safety: Stop pedalling slowly. On a spin bike the pedals keep turning.

camera.tip: Form check is not ready for this machine yet.

rowing.name: Rowing Machine
rowing.plan: 5-10 minutes at an easy pace. Focus on the order of the movement.
setup: Sit on the seat and strap your feet in. The strap goes over the widest part of your foot.
Set the damper (the lever on the fan) to 3-5.
Hold the handle with both hands, arms straight.
steps: Push with your legs first.
When your legs are almost straight, lean back a little.
Then pull the handle to your lower ribs.
Go back in the reverse order: arms, body, then legs.
mistakes: Pulling with the arms before the legs push.
Rounding the back.
Leaning back too far at the end.
rowing.safety: Keep your back straight. Do not let go of the handle while the fan is spinning.
